First, I'll list out each person's busy periods to visualize where the gaps might be.

Starting with Jacob:

Adam's schedule:

Dennis has:
- 9:00-9:30, 10:30-11:30, 13:00-15:00, 16:30-17:00. His free times are 9:30-10:30, 11:30-13:00, 15:00-16:30.

Now, I need to find a 30-minute slot that's free for all five. Let's look at possible time windows.

Looking at the earliest possible times:

From 9:00-9:30:
- Jacob's free (since his first busy is at 13:30). Wait, Jacob's first busy is 13:30. So he is free from 9:00-13:30. So 9:00-9:30 is free for him.
Diana's free here (her first block is 9:30-10:00). So 9:00-9:30 is free for her.
Adam's free? His first block is 9:30-10:30. So yes, 9:00-9:30 is free.
Angela's free here? Her first block is 9:30-10:00. So 9:00-9:30 is free for her.
Dennis's first block is 9:00-9:30. So he's busy during that entire hour. Therefore, 9:00-9:30 is not available for Dennis. So that's out.

Next possible window: Let's check 9:30-10:00. But Diana is busy here. Also, Adam is busy from 9:30-10:30. Angela is busy 9:30-10:00. So no good.

Next, 10:00-10:30. Let's check each person:

Jacob: Free (since his first busy is 13:30). So yes.
Diana: Her free time is 10:00-11:30? Wait, Diana's blocks are 9:30-10:00, then 11:30-12:00. So between 10:00-11:30 is free. So 10:00-10:30 is free for her.

How about 10:30-11:00?

Check each:

Jacob: Free.
Diana: Her free time includes 10:00-11:30? Wait, Diana's next block is 11:30-12:00. So 10:00-11:30 is free. So 10:30-11:00 is free for her.
Adam: Adam's free after 10:30? His next block is 11:00-12:30. So between 10:30-11:00 is free. Yes.
Angela: Her free times are 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30, 12:00-13:00, etc. So 10:30 is part of her busy time (10:30-12:00). So Angela is busy here. So this time is out.

Next possible time: 11:00-11:30?

Check:

Jacob: Free.
Diana: 10:00-11:30 is free. So yes.
Adam: His next free time after 10:30 is until 11:00. Wait, Adam's first block is 9:30-10:30. Then his next is 11:00-12:30. So between 10:30-11:00 is free. Then 11:00-12:30 is busy. So 11:00-11:30 is busy for Adam. So no.

How about 11:30-12:00?

Diana has a block from 11:30-12:00, so she's busy. Not good.

Next, 12:00-13:00. Let's check this window.

Jacob is free here.
Diana's free time includes 12:00-13:00 (since her next block is 13:00-13:30). So yes.
Adam's free time after 12:30? Wait, Adam's block is 11:00-12:30. So from 12:30 onwards he's free. So 12:00-12:30 is part of his busy time. Therefore, 12:00-13:00 would have the first 30 minutes as busy. So if we look for a 30-minute slot, maybe 12:30-13:00?

Let me check:

12:30-13:00.

Jacob: Free.
Diana: Her free time is up to 13:00. So yes.
Adam: His free after 12:30. So yes.
Angela: Her free time includes 12:00-13:00. Yes.
Dennis: His free time is 11:30-13:00 (since his block is 10:30-11:30 and then 13:00-15:00). So 12:30-13:00 is free for Dennis. Because Dennis is free from 11:30 to 13:00. So yes.

So 12:30-13:00 is a possible slot. Let me confirm each person:

Jacob: Not busy during that time. His busy times are 13:30-14:00 and 14:30-15:00. So 12:30-13:00 is free.
Diana: Her blocks are up to 13:00. So yes.
Adam: His block ends at 12:30. So 12:30-13:00 is free.
Angela: Her free time here is 12:00-13:00. So yes.
Dennis: Free from 11:30-13:00. So yes.

That's a 30-minute slot. So that works. Let me check if there are other possible times.

Another possible slot could be 16:30-17:00. Let's check:

Jacob: His work ends at 17:00. The meeting is half an hour. So 16:30-17:00. Jacob's busy times are 13:30-14:00 and 14:30-15:00. So he's free here.
Diana: Her block is 16:00-16:30, then free until 17:00. So 16:30-17:00 is free.
Adam: His block is 15:30-16:00. So free after 16:00. So 16:30-17:00 is okay.
Angela: Her block is 16:00-16:30, then free until 17:00. So yes.
Dennis: His block is 16:30-17:00. So he's busy during that time. Therefore, this slot is out because Dennis can't attend.

So the only viable slot is 12:30-13:00 on Monday. Let me double-check all the constraints again to be sure.

Yes, all five are free during that time. So the answer should be that time.
